notes: Kit email: results, kit report and problem reports can now send through a small web helper in the kits' Gmail – same route as updates, so Wi-Fi that blocks email doesn't stop them (Gmail app password stays as a back-up)
Power off sends the day's results (spreadsheet attached, top 3 per race in the email) and a separate kit report to the kit owner first, shown on the countdown – up to 30 s, with Turn off now
Days missed by a power cut or no internet send at the next start-up with internet
Each kit has a daily email limit (default 50); the last 10 are kept for results. Problem reports: 5 a day straight away, then one bundle an hour, then at the end of the day
Kit name for email subjects; System › Advanced › Kit email shows today's count and anything waiting
